protocol.zero_motion_encoding: Canonical positive zero in both native generator and independent byte oracle; physical zero motion unchanged.
protocol.geometry: Unchanged analytic sinusoidal diagnosis scene, camera, depths, sizes and half conversion. Samples pixel_center-image_jitter. Motion unjittered previousUV-currentUV. One context per arm, reset only at frame 0; resources retained until fence/context destruction. No cut, sharpening, mask, exposure or public API changes.
protocol.jitter: Frozen binary32 Halton(2,3), indices 1..32, period 32. Image phase=(absolute frame+start phase)%32. Correct dispatch uses the same phase. X-only/Y-only/both negation and zero change dispatch only. Lagged dispatch uses (image phase-1)%32 including wrap. Starting phase shifts both image and correct dispatch together; the temporal cycle never resets.
protocol.position: Independent sinusoid fits per RGB channel: DC + sine + cosine. Red determines X, green Y, blue checks their consistency. DC and amplitude recorded separately. Every fourth output pixel, viewport margin 8 render pixels and silhouette exclusion 8 render pixels. Phase range +/-1 render pixel per axis, amplitude ratio .25..2; empty/nonfinite/rank-deficient/unidentifiable regions fail. Bias and positive contrast changes must not become translations. Known shifts +/- .125/.25/.5/1 pixels in both regions, half conversion and out-of-range/constant/NaN controls validate the estimator before GPU dispatch.
protocol.selection_rule: For each stationary/moving group, pool each 32-frame window separately. Correct alignment X/Y/radial RMS limits = 1.25 * largest correct window across group phases + .000001; refuse any limit >= .125 render pixel (predeclared known shift defect). Correct foreground/background/edge/temporal MAE and texture NRMSE get the same selection formula and must still reject the analytic known defects. Each wrong control must exceed paired correct alignment RMS by >=10% plus .001 pixel in every window: X for negated-X, Y for negated-Y, radial for both/lagged/zero. Exploration is selection data only. Freeze limits before three fresh ordered confirmations; do not require every wrong input to lose every quality metric.
protocol.limits: 30 arms *128 =3840 frames per native block, 990 input-only frames. Native watchdog 360s; offline audit 900s. One equipment/provider/driver, correlated frames; no population confidence interval, universal image quality, perceptual guarantee, new release gate or public jitter policy.

position_controls.scope: CPU known translations, brightness/contrast and unidentifiable controls; render-pixel units

acceptance: Exploration only; no native jitter acceptance
